<title>Welcome to LWC Communities!</title>

<style>
    /* --- FAQ style --- */
    .hq-faq-wrap{
    --ham-blue:#002F86;
    --cta-blue:#3FB3FF;
    --q-color:#111C24;
    --answer-gray:#686E78;
    --sans:'Lato','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
    --serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  .hq-faq-wrap h1.page-title{
    background:var(--ham-blue);color:#fff;
    font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;font-size:30px;
    padding:23px;margin:0 0 0 0;text-align:center;
  }
  .hq-faq-wrap .ck-container{margin:0 40px;padding:0;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .top-image img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .row{margin:0 -15px;overflow:hidden;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .col-md-6{float:left;width:50%;padding:0 15px;margin-top:30px;box-sizing:border-box;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .page-tags{margin-bottom:18px;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .page-tags h3{
    font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:24px;
    color:var(--q-color);line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 10px;
  }
  .hq-faq-wrap .page-tags p{
    font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:20px;
    color:var(--answer-gray);line-height:32px;margin:0 0 10px;
  }
  .hq-faq-wrap .page-tags a{color:var(--ham-blue);text-decoration:none;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .page-tags a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
  .hq-faq-wrap p.subhead{
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:20px;
    color:var(--ham-blue);line-height:32px;margin:0 0 10px;
  }
  .hq-faq-wrap p.subhead.upper{text-transform:uppercase;}
  .hq-faq-wrap .hub-cta-button{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--cta-blue);color:var(--ham-blue);
    font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;font-size:24px;
    text-align:center;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 30px;
    border-radius:10px;margin:20px 0;
  }
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .hq-faq-wrap .ck-container{margin:0 20px;}
    .hq-faq-wrap .col-md-6{width:100%;float:none;}
  }

    /* --- DESKTOP STYLES (Screens wider than 768px) --- */
    .signup {
        max-width: 400px !important;
        margin: 1rem auto !important;   /* Centers the button horizontally with desktop spacing */
        padding: 1rem !important;  /* Replaced invalid 'auto' with a clean 2rem side padding */
    }

    /* --- MOBILE STYLES (Screens smaller than 768px) --- */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .signup {
            max-width: 90% !important;   /* Allows the button to shrink nicely to fit a phone screen */
            margin: 0.8rem auto !important;  /* Lowers the huge 20rem spacing down to a clean mobile spacing */
            padding: 0.8rem !important;
        }
        
        .loginPageImg {
            height: 50% !important;  /* Caps the height on mobile so the user doesn't scroll forever */
            object-fit: cover !important;
        }
    }
    
    /* --- DESKTOP IMAGE --- */
    .loginPageImg {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 120vh !important;     /* Takes up full vertical screen space on desktop */

    }

  /* 1. RESET: Hide all list bullets using multiple methods */

    /* Modern Input Styling */
.lwr-login-form-login input {
    height: 45px;

}

/* Focus State - When user clicks inside */

}
